VERSION 3.28.0.172

; Stock xochitl SHA256 b1816408cf90b19e448c70082625c4d6a36060368706eb7a9b35425428a9a021.
; DocumentView payload SHA256 867b30a725a4ae97e3459f07a60cd72bcafb21db9a0b374f02d75c5cd8d83269.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DocumentView.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property var piInkController: null
            readonly property string piInkCurrentDocumentUUID:
                root.document ? root.document.id.toString() : ""
        }
        TRAVERSE Item#_uiContainer > Toolbar#toolbar
            LOCATE AFTER ALL
            INSERT {
                piInkController: root.piInkController
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; MainView payload SHA256 2bc2866c59245e74af769e277e3aae801ad76bc7f816f24ccf1fc7ac4f5e3cfc.
; The persistent client has no visual or input footprint. Its panel is reparented
; into the active native content pane, never the top-level MainView overlay.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/main/MainView.qml
    TRAVERSE Background#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Binding {
                target: navigator
                property: "piInkController"
                value: piInkToolbarLoader.item
            }
            Binding {
                target: documentView.item
                property: "piInkController"
                value: piInkToolbarLoader.item
                when: !!documentView.item
            }
            Loader {
                id: piInkToolbarLoader
                width: 0
                height: 0
                readonly property bool editing: !!documentView.item?.documentLoaded
                Component.onCompleted: setSource(
                    "file:///home/root/pi-ink-bridge-0020/tablet-qml/PiInkToolbar.qml",
                    {
                        nativeDocumentUUID: Qt.binding(function() {
                            return documentView.item ? documentView.item.piInkCurrentDocumentUUID : "";
                        }),
                        library: Library,
                        panelParent: navigator,
                        panelEnabled: Qt.binding(function() {
                            return rootItem.visible && !root.passcodeHandler.userLocked &&
                                !piInkToolbarLoader.editing && navigator.visible;
                        }),
                        panelLeftMargin: Qt.binding(function() {
                            return navigator.sidebar.visible ? navigator.sidebar.width : 0;
                        }),
                        panelRightMargin: Qt.binding(function() {
                            return 0;
                        }),
                        panelTopMargin: Qt.binding(function() {
                            return navigator.piInkContentTop;
                        }),
                        panelBottomMargin: Qt.binding(function() {
                            return Values.navigatorStatusbarHeight;
                        })
                    })
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Native toolbar payload SHA256 f0f552fa18a27733b59fafddc1a1cd10e35328136eb56cbb695c8799e91483f6.
; Reserve one native tool slot. Preserve existing extensions' tool-count handler.
AFFECT /qt/qml/xofm/libs/toolbar/qml/Toolbar.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property var piInkController: null
        }
        REPLACE showableToolsCount WITH {
            readonly property int showableToolsCount:
                Math.floor(Math.max(innerWidth, innerHeight) / ArkTokens.Style.variable.controlsHeight.large) -
                1 - (root.piInkController ? 1 : 0)
        }
        REPLACE shownToolsCount WITH {
            readonly property int shownToolsCount:
                editingTools.count + secondaryTools.count + (root.piInkController ? 1 : 0)
        }
        TRAVERSE Item#toolbar > GridLayout#toolLayout
            LOCATE BEFORE ToolbarTool#tocButton
            INSERT {
                ToolbarTool {
                    id: piInkSidebarTool
                    objectName: "pi-ink-sidebar-button"
                    toolbar: root
                    type: ToolbarTool.Type.ToolbarButton
                    label: "Pi Ink"
                    iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/link"
                    shouldShow: !!root.piInkController
                    visible: shouldShow && root.expanded
                    onPressed: root._select(piInkSidebarTool)
                    foldoutContent: ColumnLayout {
                        spacing: 0
                        ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            label: root.piInkController?.statusText ?? "Bridge offline"
                            description: root.piInkController?.errorText ?? ""
                            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/link"
                            enabled: false
                        }
                        ArkControls.FoldoutItem {
                            property string documentAtPress: ""
                            property string confirmationAtPress: ""
                            readonly property bool confirming:
                                root.piInkController?.state.status === "confirmation-required"
                            Layout.fillWidth: true
                            label: confirming ? "Confirm clipping and send" : "Send"
                            description: confirming ?
                                "Ink outside the source will be clipped. The full PDF is retained; the stock document stays editable." : ""
                            iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/share"
                            enabled: !!root.piInkController?.currentMatches &&
                                !root.piInkController.actionBusy &&
                                (confirming ? !!root.piInkController.state.canConfirm &&
                                    !!root.piInkController.state.confirmationId :
                                    !!root.piInkController.state.canSend)
                            onPressed: {
                                documentAtPress = root.piInkController.documentUUID;
                                confirmationAtPress = confirming ?
                                    root.piInkController.state.confirmationId : "";
                            }
                            onClicked: root.piInkController.submit(
                                confirmationAtPress ? "/confirm" : "/send",
                                documentAtPress, confirmationAtPress)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Navigator payload SHA256 28c1f04f5c70bdd864019950367d08191d3e7eb8cd536e3b9e8a58e7bc9da164.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Navigator.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property var piInkController: null
            readonly property real piInkContentTop: contentHeader.height
        }
        TRAVERSE Sidebar#_sidebar
            LOCATE AFTER ALL
            INSERT {
                piInkController: root.piInkController
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT

; Sidebar payload SHA256 5cfd661e6c68c343513d9ca034042ee3f5cdc3ab0df77ea0396838c77135adc0.
AFFECT /qml/device/view/navigator/Sidebar.qml
    TRAVERSE FocusScope#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property var piInkController: null
        }
        TRAVERSE ColumnLayout#filterColumn
            LOCATE BEFORE Common.Background#spacer
            INSERT {
                ArkControls.SidebarItem {
                    objectName: "pi-ink-library-sidebar-button"
                    text: "Pi Ink"
                    iconSource: "qrc:/ark/icons/link"
                    highlighted: !!root.piInkController?.expanded
                    visible: !!root.piInkController
                    Layout.preferredWidth: parent.width
                    onClicked: {
                        root.hide();
                        root.piInkController.showManager();
                    }
                }
            }
        END TRAVERSE
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
